correctness.rationale: Differentiate p(t)=[1:t:...:t^d] in char2; odd derivative coordinates survive, even ones vanish. For tangent parameter lambda, putting u=t² and v=t+lambda gives even coordinates u^j and odd coordinates vu^j. On projective closure these are the standard monomial parametrizations of S(m,m-1) if d=2m, and S(m,m) if d=2m+1. Both summands positive for d>=3 so image is smooth and degree a+b=d-1. Image function field is k(u,v) while incidence source is k(t,v), giving purely inseparable degree2. Direct parity and monomial checks for d=3..19 support the uniform algebraic proof; no finite extrapolation used.
